intro: The Offering of Blood is a mysterious ritual performed at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril. Using a Tortured Soul, adventurers give an offering of blood at the stone, as the scrap of note called for.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All that's left now is the offering of blood.
The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'
An intense sense of dread washes over you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.
The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.
Something glitters from within the remnants...

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
